# Tokenization Systems

> Independent research, advisory, and infrastructure practice on digital money, tokenization, and tokenomics. Eight SSRN working papers and eight federal comment letters across the GENIUS Act and related dockets, filed across a 10-day window in April 2026. Run by Zach Zukowski (six years as Senior Investment Analyst at Borderless Capital).

Site: https://tokenization.systems
Contact: zach@tokenization.systems

## Research

- [All research](https://tokenization.systems/research): Eight-paper program across Track A (stablecoins, gateways, settlement infrastructure) and Track B (tokenomics, DePIN, protocol-network governance).
- [Routing the Dollar](https://tokenization.systems/papers/routing-the-dollar): Stablecoin stress performance varies by gateway, not by token. Three descriptive findings from 34 months of on-chain data. Prepared for FRBNY's Fifth Conference on International Roles of the U.S. Dollar (June 2026).
- [Minimum Viable Equivalence Pack (MVEP)](https://tokenization.systems/papers/mvep): Ten-category committee checklist testing whether a tokenized product maintains equivalence under stress. Reverse-engineered from the SVB weekend.
- [Governance Concentration Beyond Token Allocation](https://tokenization.systems/papers/governance-concentration): In peer review at Frontiers in Blockchain (Blockchain Economics).
- [Three Tokenization Strategies](https://tokenization.systems/papers/three-strategies): Institutional tokenization is proceeding through three distinct strategies; Securitize is transfer agent in all three.

## Frameworks

- [Frameworks](https://tokenization.systems/frameworks): Diligence frameworks the program publishes.
- Control Layer Intensity Index (CLII): five-dimension regulatory-posture score for stablecoin gateways.
- Minimum Viable Equivalence Pack (MVEP): ten-category diligence framework for institutional tokenization.
- MVEP-AI: ten-category framework adapted for AI-operator diligence (composed-product, foundation-model, agentic systems).
- CLII-AI: five-dimension regulatory-posture score for AI operators (Tier 1/2/3 placement).
- FQPSI / PPSI: federal payment-stablecoin issuer diligence frameworks.

## Federal comment letters

- [All letters](https://tokenization.systems/letters): Eight federal comment letters across seven rulemakings, six docket records, to five federal agencies. Submissions completing April 20, 2026.
- Covers OCC bank stablecoin engagement, Treasury GENIUS Act state similarity, FDIC payment-stablecoin reserve standards and subsidiary-issuance approvals, FinCEN AML/CFT and Permitted Payment Stablecoin Issuer (PPSI) sanctions, and joint banking AML/CFT.

## Research infrastructure

A cited-research system architecture underlies the program: hundreds of academic sources in a graph-indexed substrate with nine AI-integration patterns for paper drafting, synthesis, revision-impact analysis, cluster discovery, bibliography generation, cross-paper claim synthesis, verbatim quote retrieval, author cluster discovery, and reverse-index lookup. The program's multi-session coordination architecture, the Canonical-State Architecture, is patent-pending (USPTO provisionals 64/071,767 and 19/693,448, filed May 2026); the methodology paper documenting the substrate is in development.

## Resume profiles

- [Asset management](https://tokenization.systems/resume/asset-management): Research, diligence, and decision frameworks for tokenized products and institutional capital allocation.
- [Policy and central banking](https://tokenization.systems/resume/policy): Research on digital money, stablecoins, settlement, and control-layer infrastructure for policy and market-infrastructure roles.
- [AI governance and infrastructure](https://tokenization.systems/resume/ai-governance-infrastructure): AI-operator diligence and accountability frameworks (MVEP-AI, CLII-AI).
- [Risk and controls](https://tokenization.systems/resume/risk-controls): Stress scenarios, finality, and operational risk for tokenized products.
- [Product](https://tokenization.systems/resume/product): Product strategy for digital-money and tokenized-asset platforms.
- [Stablecoin and payments](https://tokenization.systems/resume/stablecoin-payments): Gateway routing, reserve mechanics, and payment-stablecoin operator diligence.
